opening.argument: The video presents a step-by-step guide to YouTube monetization, explaining watch-time requirements and possible earnings from views. It directs viewers to YouTube Studio to check watch time, while expressly warning that sub-to-sub activity violates YouTube policy. Those are educational and operational instructions, not a concrete offer requiring payment, credentials, or financial participation. The earnings discussion gives viewers an idea of what views might earn; it does not promise a guaranteed return or identify any required transaction or way to transfer money or data.
